intelligent-console.title: Intelligent Copy Test
intelligent-console.heading: Intelligent Copy Test
intelligent-console.intro: Save shared generation settings. Tests do not send group messages, mute users, or change group state; results are added to activity records.

mode.label: Generation mode
mode.astrbot_help: Use an AstrBot-configured chat provider; a blank provider follows the triggering session.
mode.manual_help: Connect directly to an OpenAI-compatible service. Direct generation requires a saved API base URL, API key, and custom model ID, without the AstrBot chat-provider catalog.
mode.manual_description: Connect directly to an OpenAI-compatible service

provider.label: Chat provider
provider.help: A blank provider follows the triggering group-message session and cannot be tested from this page.

manual_api_base.label: API Base URL
manual_api_base.help: OpenAI-compatible direct mode only. Direct generation also needs a saved API key and custom model ID. Enter the compatible service root, including any service-required version path.

manual_api_key.label: API Key
manual_api_key.placeholder: Leave blank to retain the saved key
manual_api_key.help: OpenAI-compatible direct mode only. Direct generation also needs a saved API base URL and custom model ID. Leave this input blank to retain the saved key; this page never echoes it.
manual_api_key.configured: Saved; this page never displays the key.
manual_api_key.clear_confirm: Clear the saved API key? This saves immediately and cannot be undone.

model.label: Custom model ID
model.placeholder: AstrBot mode: leave blank unless overriding the chat provider's model
model.manual_placeholder: OpenAI-compatible direct mode requires a custom model ID
model.help: In AstrBot mode, use this only to override the chat provider's model. Choose a candidate or enter a custom model ID.
model.manual_help: OpenAI-compatible direct mode requires a custom model ID and does not enumerate third-party models.
model.blank_provider_help: Without a selected chat provider, production messages follow the triggering session and this page cannot run a test. A custom model ID still overrides the chat provider's model.
model.unavailable: Model candidates are unavailable; a custom model ID can still be entered.
model.provider_selected: Provider-selected model (no custom model ID specified)

runtime.mute_on: Intelligent mute notice: enabled after a successful mute

repeat.title: Intelligent interrupt test
repeat.description: Generates one test copy with the saved interrupt prompt. No group message is sent.

mute.title: Intelligent mute notice test
mute.description: Generates copy for “Test user / 60 seconds”. It never mutes, sends a message, or changes group state.

history.kicker: Select a record to view call details
history.title: LLM call records
history.empty: There are no records in this time range.

clear.confirm: Clear all LLM call records? This cannot be undone.

history.privacy: Records retain repeated content, LLM requests, and replies for review here. Data older than seven days is cleaned in the background.

common.configuration_not_loaded: Load the saved configuration before saving changes.
common.unknown_error: The operation failed. Please try again later.
